response.rationale: The item is electronics delivered 8 days ago (<=15), so RET-002 applies (priority 20) and controls over the standard 30-day window rule RET-007 (priority 10). No higher-priority rules apply: not final sale (RET-012), not defective (RET-020), no goodwill grant (RET-050), and no fraud hold (RET-051). Therefore the return is eligible.
